newsitem.title: USA: Hollinger plans no equity issue under shelf.
newsitem.headline: Hollinger plans no equity issue under shelf.

text.p: Hollinger International Inc said on Thursday it has no intention of utilizing its universal shelf registration statements to issue forms of equity in the foreseeable future at current prices or at prices that have prevailed during the past year.
This includes any instrument that is convertible into or tied to the market price of the company's common stock, it said.

The company said its universal shelf registration statement and that of its subsidiary, Hollinger International Publishing, have been accorded "no review" treatment by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Hollinger said that it has no current significant acquisition plans that would cause it to make these registration statements become effective.
The registration statements, however, may be utilized to issue debt instruments to re-finance some of its existing short-term debt, it said.
